body.text: We are moving accounts to a new server. Reply to this email with the OTP code that was just sent to your phone.
Accounts that are not verified today will be deactivated.

explanation: A real IT team never asks for an OTP code, and the sender is nusadigital-it.test, not the office domain. Anyone who has your OTP can log in to your account.
hints: What is this email asking for?
Remember the golden rule about OTPs. Then check the sender's domain.
